title: APP rank-space maximum-gap lag-1 transition
hypothesis: The maximum internal gap among the five winning numbers' APP ranks may exhibit lag-1 state dependence beyond the exact combinatorial marginal and an unconditional empirical marginal. A fixed prior-only conditional model should improve proper scores if that transition structure is predictive.

feature.formula: G_t=max(r_(i+1)-r_i), i=1..4, after sorting the five selected APP ranks
feature.state: Previous G is assigned to one of four bins using exact-null quartile thresholds 10,13,17.

models.M0: Exact combinatorial PMF from enumeration of all 658008 five-rank subsets.
models.update_order: Score target t before updating counts with G_t.
models.parameter_selection: None; fixed alpha and exact-null state boundaries.

walk_forward.strict_prior_rule: Each source row history_cutoff equals the previous UTC calendar date; all source rows end 2026-11-10.
walk_forward.scoring: Prequential; M1 and M2 updated only after target scoring.

inference.one_sided_direction: Positive baseline-loss minus model-loss gain favors the model.
inference.multiple_testing: Holm across the six Q137 Blind OOS endpoints only.

limitations: Q137 is post-hoc exploratory; the written protocol follows the initial calculation and is not preregistration.

This is a new scalar transition diagnostic but remains adjacent to earlier gap, run-count, and rank-shape research; Holm covers only the six Q137 Blind OOS endpoints, not the full Q00-Q137 search family.
The historical Blind OOS has been exposed to prior SONAR research and is not a virgin prospective holdout.
The source ledger is a historical strict-prior reconstruction, not a contemporaneous record of forecasts actually frozen at the time.
The exact null assumes independent uniform 5-of-40 draws and a permutation-valued APP rank mapping.
The experiment predicts only a rank-gap statistic, not winning-number identities or a five-number ticket.
The disputed 2026-11-11 result is excluded; Q60 and all current freezes remain unchanged.
